description.value: Lake Country Liquor Store is a full-service retail liquor shop located between Kelowna and Vernon in Lake Country, BC, stocking an extensive range of craft and import beers, wines, spirits, coolers, and ciders. Staff are described as well-trained and knowledgeable, and the store offers case lot pricing and price-matching against other local retailers. For touring cyclists traveling the Okanagan corridor, it serves as a convenient stop for beverages and supplies.

address.value: 72-9522 Main Street, Lake Country, BC V4V 2L9
